合わせる: to join together; to unite; to combine; to add up
ぶつかる: to encounter; to meet with; to come upon; to face
出張る: to go somewhere (e.g. for work); to proceed to; to leave for; to go on an official tour
流す: to drain; to pour; to run; to let flow
絡む: to be involved (e.g. of money in a matter); to get involved (in); to be a factor (in); to have an influence
ごまかす: to evade (a question, taxes, etc.); to dodge; to gloss over (a mistake, fault, etc.); to smooth over
追い込む: to corner; to force someone into doing
楽: easy; simple; without trouble; without hardships
とばっちり: chance blow; by-blow; getting dragged into (a quarrel, etc.); getting mixed up in
吐き出す: to spend (e.g. saved money); to cough up
退場: leaving (a hall, meeting, stadium, etc.); exit; walkout
狩り: hunting down (a criminal, etc.); rounding up (e.g. communists); witch-hunt
実行: execution (e.g. of a plan); carrying out; (putting into) practice; action
弁える: to know (manners, one's place, etc.); to understand; to bear in mind
繋がる: to lead (to an outcome); to bring about (a result)

__flags__.文: ビタ一文 = 'not a single mon (coin)', set phrase; 文 as monetary unit, not 'literature'
__flags__.突き立つ: 突っ立ってる = 突っ立つ 'stand around idly'
__flags__.大目: 大目に見る set phrase 'overlook leniently'
